purpose: Record owner-approved component adoption separately from semantic edit approval and independent quality verification.

policy.component_adoption_gate: OWNER_ATTESTED_INTEGRATE permits a capability to enter future mainline runs; it does not claim independent verification, human semantic approval, Champion promotion, or publish approval.
policy.semantic_edit_gate: human_accept or an explicitly promoted, bounded autocut policy remains the only authority for a semantic deletion action.
policy.verification_order: Independent audit, benchmark, and rollback verification may happen after mainline integration; a defect reopens only the affected capability scope and never rewrites historical run evidence.
prohibited_conflations: owner attestation is not an independent benchmark result
machine output is not a human decision
a Challenger remains rollbackable after integration

mainline.mainline_scope: candidate generation -> canonical candidate normalization -> high-risk human review -> EDL only after human_accept
mainline.reopen_trigger: false positive, missing retry span, boundary mismatch, or cross-track conflict

mainline.mainline_scope: candidate generation -> canonical transient candidate -> high-risk source-track review -> source_track_gate only after human_accept
mainline.safety: human_review_required; cough is never a global semantic cut and mic_bump/thump remain disabled unless separately enabled
mainline.reopen_trigger: false positive, speech veto miss, wrong source track, or gate/render mismatch

mainline.mainline_scope: post-EDL mix stage with run-local manifest, output SHA, loudness/QC and rollback to direct-mix
mainline.safety: mixing only; cannot create or alter semantic EDL actions
mainline.reopen_trigger: pumping, speech suppression, primary-track error, loudness drift, or missing provenance

mainline.mainline_scope: apply source_track_gate actions before mix while preserving global timeline and action provenance
mainline.safety: track-local only; never represented as a global semantic cut
mainline.reopen_trigger: duration change, wrong-track mute, gate hash mismatch, or cross-track leakage

mainline.mainline_scope: music sidechain/ducking parameters frozen in run manifest and independently reversible
mainline.source: main/orchestrator/music_templates.json and owner-confirmed Claude Code implementation evidence
mainline.safety: audio level automation only; never changes semantic content or EDL boundaries
mainline.reopen_trigger: music masks speech, incorrect timing, gain/pumping artifact, or release-spec mismatch

mainline.mainline_scope: ordinary new runs use the audited local adapter; source SHA, output SHA and license/audit record stay in the run
mainline.safety: raw audio remains read-only; changed binary/parameters reopen the audit

mainline.mainline_scope: new capabilities are invoked through a registered Tool + Skill/adapter contract, with direct orchestrator fallback during parity rollout

mainline.safety: adapter output paths, writes policy, SHA and rollback must be validated before production use
mainline.reopen_trigger: adapter drift, output escape, missing provenance, overwrite, or failed recovery
